comments.body:
Name: Galileo's Military Compass
Historical Relic
Description:
A calculator invented by Galileo Galilei that can determine the amount of gunpowder for cannons and shells of any inner diameter. It is said that it could be used for various calculations, as a protractor, and for recording astronomical observations. Galileo, who was a professor at the University of Padua, was said to have earned money from this compass.
